title: US Yields Will Go Much Higher Next Year: 3-Minutes MLIV
titleChinese: 明年美国收益率将大幅上升：3分钟MLIV
summary: 美国收益率预计将在明年大幅上升，10年期国债收益率可能达到5%甚至更高，30年期国债收益率可能突破6%，这是由于全球经济增长强劲、政府支出高以及私营部门支出增加等因素驱动的结果

transcript.english: It is CPI day in the USA.
transcript.chinese: 今天是美国的CPI日。

transcript.english: Does the U.S.
transcript.chinese: 美国有

transcript.english: have an inflation problem?
transcript.chinese: 通货膨胀问题吗？

transcript.english: Uh, absolutely.
transcript.chinese: 嗯，绝对有。

transcript.english: Is it one that's going to be exacerbated by today's print?
transcript.chinese: 今天的数据是否会加剧这种问题？

transcript.english: Probably not.
transcript.chinese: 可能不会。

transcript.english: Expectations are for it to come in, uh, at a low level and to kind of dissuade the Hawks in the short term, I think, with with expectations for such a low print, though, we'll probably get an asymmetric reaction function if it is slightly stronger than expected rather than if it's on the softer side.
transcript.chinese: 预计今天的数据会低于预期，这可能会在短期内缓解鹰派的压力，但如果数据略高于预期，可能会引发不对称的反应函数，相比之下，如果数据偏软，反应可能会较为平淡。

transcript.english: But I think a way for the CPI.
transcript.chinese: 但是我认为CPI

transcript.chinese: CPI绝对是本周最重要的宏观数据发布，它将引发短期交易，但我认为除了今天的数据发布之外，美国国债的整体环境是越来越具挑战性和负面。

transcript.english: And I do think that we'll see much higher U.S. yields into the end of year, no matter what happens over the next 48 hours.
transcript.chinese: 而且我认为，无论接下来的48小时发生什么，我们都将看到美国收益率在年底前大幅上升。

transcript.english: On that note, then, obviously, U.S.
transcript.chinese: 基于此，很明显，美国

transcript.chinese: 政策制定者对更高的收益率感到担忧。

transcript.english: Just how high can we go and would you expect a policy response?
transcript.chinese: 那么，收益率可能会升高到什么程度，我们是否会看到政策反应？

transcript.english: Uh, I think we're going a lot higher in US yields.
transcript.chinese: 嗯，我认为美国收益率还会大幅上升。

transcript.english: I just think US yields are crazy at this level.
transcript.chinese: 我认为当前的美国收益率水平太低了。

transcript.english: And I think the global growth is super strong and into a super, super strong as maybe 2 to 2 strong wording.
transcript.chinese: 我认为全球经济增长非常强劲，可能达到2%甚至更高。

transcript.english: It is strong global growth.
transcript.chinese: 这是强劲的全球经济增长。

transcript.chinese: 这是良好的全球经济增长。

transcript.chinese: 尤其是在美国，经济增长是良好的。

transcript.chinese: 政府支出在全球范围内仍然非常高。

transcript.chinese: 并且，我们有大量的私营部门支出，这将导致经济过热。

transcript.english: So I ultimately expect us to go significantly higher.
transcript.chinese: 因此，我最终预计我们将会看到显著更高的收益率。

transcript.english: I think we're going way to that.
transcript.chinese: 我认为我们会走向更高的水平。

transcript.english: I think 30 year yields will go through 6% next year.
transcript.chinese: 我认为30年期国债收益率将突破6%。

transcript.english: I really think we're going to much higher levels.
transcript.chinese: 我真的认为我们将会看到更高的水平。

transcript.english: It's about the pace.
transcript.chinese: 这取决于步伐。

transcript.english: I don't know how quickly I'll get there.
transcript.chinese: 我不知道我们会以多快的速度到达那里。

transcript.english: What I'm curious is does it happen this year?
transcript.chinese: 我想知道的是，这是否会在今年发生。

transcript.english: I don't know, I'm open minded to the idea, but I'm not saying they're going to get there really fast.
transcript.chinese: 我不知道，我对这个想法持开放态度，但我并不是说它们会很快到达那里。

transcript.english: But I think U.S.
transcript.chinese: 但是我认为美国

transcript.english: yields are still going a lot higher still.
transcript.chinese: 收益率仍将大幅上升。

transcript.english: Okay, 5% is the floor potentially for the US ten year.
transcript.chinese: 好吧，5%可能是美国10年期国债收益率的底线。

transcript.english: Maybe that's the headline of the day.
transcript.chinese: 也许这是今天的头条新闻。

transcript.chinese: 也许今天的头条新闻是Mark Cudmore对英国的看法。

transcript.chinese: 我们在欧洲和美国看到越来越多的积极迹象。

transcript.english: And so I think those global growth factors, uh, figures need to get upgraded.
transcript.chinese: 因此，我认为这些全球经济增长因素需要被上调。

transcript.english: But it's not just like in Germany.
transcript.chinese: 但这不仅仅是在德国。

transcript.chinese: 德国是一个伟大的故事。

transcript.english: It's really good.
transcript.chinese: 这是一个非常好的故事。

transcript.english: I think UK longer term has been very impressive.
transcript.chinese: 我认为英国长期来看非常令人印象深刻。

transcript.english: And it was interesting that world Bank figures came out recently and confirmed that the UK has that India to go back to reclaim fifth spot in the global rankings of global GDP.

transcript.english: Uh, and I think that really kind of, uh, challenges the narrative that the UK is kind of doomed and stagnant forevermore.
